column_detail.name: timestamp_local
column_detail.note: Microsecond precision. The trailing -05:00 is the offset from Coordinated Universal Time, i.e. US Central Daylight Time.

column_detail.name: lat
column_detail.note: Position north of the equator, in WGS 84 (World Geodetic System 1984, the reference frame GPS reports in). Seven decimal places.

column_detail.name: lon
column_detail.note: Position east of the prime meridian; negative means west. Seven decimal places.

column_detail.name: ping_ms
column_detail.note: How long a small packet took to reach the server and return. ms = millisecond, one thousandth of a second.

column_detail.name: uplink
column_detail.note: Rate from device to network, measured with iperf. Mbps = megabits per second. Never appears without downlink.

column_detail.name: downlink
column_detail.note: Rate from network to device. Never appears without uplink.

column_detail.name: band
column_detail.note: Human-readable name for the slice of spectrum in use. One value only, so it carries no information beyond present or absent.

column_detail.name: cellid
column_detail.note: Which individual cell (one sector of one base station) the device was camped on. Read as text: leading zeros are significant.

column_detail.name: arfcn
column_detail.note: The integer index that names a carrier frequency. In 5G New Radio this is the NR-ARFCN; 630720 corresponds to 3460.8 MHz. Two values only.

column_detail.group_note: all three arrive as whole numbers
column_detail.name: rsrp
column_detail.note: Power the device received on the cell's always-on reference signal. dBm = decibels relative to one milliwatt, so values are negative and more negative is weaker.

column_detail.group_note: all three arrive as whole numbers
column_detail.name: sinr
column_detail.note: How far the wanted signal sits above interference plus background noise. dB = decibel, a ratio on a logarithmic scale; higher is a cleaner channel.

column_detail.group_note: all three arrive as whole numbers
column_detail.name: rsrq
column_detail.note: Quality rather than raw strength: it folds in how loaded the carrier is. Closer to zero is better.

glossary.note: An integer index that names a carrier frequency, so a channel can be written as one number instead of a frequency in megahertz. The 5G variant is the NR-ARFCN; 630720 here maps to 3460.8 MHz.
Power the handset measures on the cell's always-on reference signal. Reported in dBm, so values are negative and more negative means weaker.
How far the wanted signal sits above interference plus background noise. Higher is a cleaner channel.
Quality rather than raw strength: it folds in how loaded the carrier is. Closer to zero is better.
Names one sector of one base station. A three-sector site has three of them.
One thousandth of a second.
One million bits per second. Eight bits to a byte, so 8 Mbps is one megabyte per second.
An absolute power level on a logarithmic scale. Every 10 dB down is ten times less power, so -80 dBm is ten times weaker than -70 dBm.
A ratio between two quantities on a logarithmic scale. Unlike dBm it is relative, not an absolute amount.
The 3GPP term for the device on the customer side of the link. Here, the modem in the vehicle.
The radio half of a mobile network: the base stations and antennas that connect devices to the core network.
Standard vendor equipment bought as sold, rather than research hardware built for the experiment.
The 5G air interface. Band n78 is its 3.3-3.8 GHz mid-band allocation.
Uplink and downlink share one frequency and take turns in time, rather than using two separate frequencies.
The satellite system the lat and lon columns come from.
The coordinate reference frame GPS reports positions in.
The utility that produced the uplink and downlink numbers by pushing traffic and timing it.
The plain-text table format the dataset ships in.
The 'cumulative' panel on each column card: for any value on the horizontal axis it reads off what share of rows fall at or below it.
p50 is the median, so half the values fall below it. p90 means nine tenths fall below it. p1 and p99 bound the extremes without being a single outlier.
